Q01.answer: A full‑time permanent UK employee is entitled to **25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year**, in addition to the England and Wales bank holidays [annual_leave#eligibility].
Q01.context:
<excerpt id="annual_leave#eligibility" document="Annual leave" doc_id="NS-ANNUAL-LEAVE" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Annual leave > Eligibility

Permanent UK employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus England and Wales bank holidays. Part-time entitlement is pro-rated by contracted weekly hours. Contractors are outside this policy. The leave year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="sickness_absence#company-sick-pay" document="Sickness absence" doc_id="NS-SICKNESS-ABSENCE" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Sickness absence > Company sick pay

Permanent UK employees who have passed probation receive up to 10 working days of company sick pay at full base pay per calendar year. Employees still on probation should ask the People team about their pay arrangements. Statutory sick pay eligibility, rates and interaction with company pay are not specified here.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="parental_leave#scope-and-eligibility" document="Enhanced parental leave" doc_id="NS-PARENTAL-LEAVE" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Enhanced parental leave > Scope and eligibility

This policy describes fictional enhanced company benefits for permanent UK employees with at least 26 weeks of continuous service by the expected week of birth or placement. Contractors are outside this policy. It does not provide a complete statement of statutory entitlements; ask the People team about statutory rights or eligibility outside this enhancement.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="annual_leave#carry-over" document="Annual leave" doc_id="NS-ANNUAL-LEAVE" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Annual leave > Carry-over

Up to 5 unused days may be carried into the next calendar year with line-manager approval recorded by 15 December. Carried days must be used by 31 March. This demo policy does not describe statutory exceptions or individual contractual arrangements; refer those questions to the People team.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="annual_leave#how-to-request" document="Annual leave" doc_id="NS-ANNUAL-LEAVE" version="2.0" status="current" effective_from="20261001">
Annual leave > How to request

Submit requests in PeopleHub at least 10 working days before the first day of leave. Your line manager approves or declines within 3 working days. Do not treat a submitted request as approved. Requests for more than 10 consecutive working days also need approval from Priya Shah, Head of People.
</excerpt>

judge.rationale: The answer correctly states the 25 days plus bank holidays as per the reference and is fully supported by the provided excerpt.
